projects.name: AAITS website & CMS

projects.name: Magrofy Social Engine
projects.summary: SiteCast is a multi-brand agentic content platform for the Magrofy website network. A run moves through Scout, Strategist, Writer, Illustrator, Guardian, Repurposer and Publisher stages with structured JSON outputs, risk tiering, and human approval gates at every exit — an operator picks a site, the model drafts the article and a hero image, a person approves it, and SiteCast publishes to that site's own API and promotes it from that site's own X account. Every website is a Publishing Channel — endpoint, auth type, encrypted credential and a JSON payload template — so adding a site is configuration, not code. Seven are wired up today. Nothing ships unattended: credentials are verified before every publish, scheduled runs are idempotent, and a global kill switch blocks all publishing.
